entries.title: 2 Chronicles 8:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The house - He built this house for her; because the ark was now in the house of David, which therefore ought to be kept pure and free from the very danger and appearance of pollution.

entries.title: 2 Chronicles 8:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Man of God - A prophet inspired by God in these matters, whose commands therefore are the commands of God.

entries.title: 2 Chronicles 8:16
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Prepared - All the materials were procured, and in all points fitted and compleated before - hand.
